name: saltcorn-samba
description: Saltcorn plugin: browse, upload, rename and delete files on one or more Samba/CIFS shares via SMB 3.1.1 (AES-CMAC signing, optional encryption). File-manager view, directory tree, inline PDF viewer, external-app open (smb://).

scripts.test: node test/sanitize.test.js && node test/connections.test.js && node test/view-token.test.js
